verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented on the AgentOS page. AgentOS is described as a toolkit that lets AI agents act on a production Airwallex account (balances, beneficiaries, cards, cashflow reports). Separate developer connectors link coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code and Codex to the docs and sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit MCP setup/transport and tool-list details in the excerpts, independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
